vision: Premium gourmet salsa e-commerce platform bringing 35+ years of authentic New Mexico-style family recipes direct to customers

target_audience.primary: Gourmet salsa enthusiasts and food lovers seeking premium, artisan salsa products made with quality ingredients
secondary: Wholesale partners (grocery stores, gourmet shops, retailers)
Fundraising organizations (schools, churches, sports teams, nonprofits)
Gift shoppers looking for unique food gifts
Health-conscious consumers interested in authentic, quality ingredients

phases.description: Address critical technical debt, security issues, and implement quick-win features that improve core e-commerce functionality

milestones.title: Secure Email Configuration
milestones.description: SMTP passwords are encrypted at rest and securely handled throughout the application

milestones.title: Complete Checkout Experience
milestones.description: Shipping costs are accurately calculated and tax exemptions work for eligible customers

milestones.title: Enhanced Heat Level Discovery
milestones.description: Customers can easily understand and find products matching their heat preference

phases.name: Growth & Differentiation
phases.description: Launch subscription program and loyalty rewards to drive recurring revenue and customer retention - key differentiators from competitors

milestones.title: Subscription Program Launch
milestones.description: Customers can subscribe for regular salsa deliveries with customizable preferences

milestones.title: Loyalty Program Live
milestones.description: Customers earn and redeem points for purchases, creating stickiness and repeat business

milestones.title: Enhanced Shopping Experience
milestones.description: Product comparison and ingredient transparency help customers make confident purchase decisions

phases.name: Channel Expansion
phases.description: Strengthen wholesale and fundraising channels with improved tools and expand customer engagement features

milestones.title: Fundraising Program 2.0
milestones.description: Organizations can easily manage campaigns with online ordering and real-time tracking

milestones.title: Customer Engagement Hub
milestones.description: Heat preference quiz and referral program drive discovery and word-of-mouth growth

milestones.title: Wholesale Portal Enhancement
milestones.description: Wholesale partners have streamlined ordering with better inventory visibility

phases.name: Future Vision
phases.description: Long-term features for market expansion and new customer segments

milestones.title: Mobile Experience
milestones.description: Native mobile app provides convenient shopping and push notifications

milestones.title: Gift & Corporate Expansion
milestones.description: Custom gift bundles and corporate ordering capture new market segments

features.title: SMTP Password Encryption
features.description: Implement encryption for SMTP passwords stored in the database. Passwords should be encrypted at rest using AES-256 and decrypted only when needed for email sending.
features.rationale: Security requirement - storing passwords in plaintext is a significant vulnerability. This protects customer data and email infrastructure credentials.
acceptance_criteria: SMTP passwords are encrypted before storage in database
Passwords are decrypted only when establishing SMTP connection
Existing unencrypted passwords are migrated to encrypted format
Admin can update SMTP password without issues
user_stories: As an admin, I want email credentials stored securely so that our email infrastructure is protected from unauthorized access

features.title: Shipping Cost Calculator
features.description: Implement dynamic shipping cost calculation based on order weight, destination, and shipping method. Support flat-rate, weight-based, and real-time carrier rates.
features.rationale: Currently returns $0 which impacts revenue and customer expectations. Accurate shipping costs are essential for a functional e-commerce checkout experience.
acceptance_criteria: Shipping cost calculated based on package weight and dimensions
Support for multiple shipping zones with different rates
Free shipping threshold configurable by admin
Shipping options displayed clearly at checkout
Integration with at least one carrier API (USPS/UPS/FedEx) for real-time rates
user_stories: As a customer, I want to see accurate shipping costs at checkout so that I know the total cost before purchasing
As an admin, I want to configure shipping rates so that I can balance customer satisfaction with business profitability

features.title: Tax Exemption System
features.description: Implement tax exemption lookup and application for eligible customers including nonprofits, wholesale accounts, and fundraising organizations.
features.rationale: Supports wholesale and fundraising programs which are key differentiators. Many organizations require tax-exempt ordering capability.
acceptance_criteria: Wholesale accounts can be marked as tax-exempt with certificate storage
Tax exemption automatically applied at checkout for eligible accounts
Admin can manage tax exemption certificates and expiration dates
Tax exemption status visible in order details and invoices
user_stories: As a wholesale partner, I want my tax-exempt status applied automatically so that I don't have to manually claim exemptions
As a fundraising organization, I want to purchase without sales tax so that more funds go to our cause

features.title: Enhanced Heat Level Discovery
features.description: Improve the heat level filtering and display system with detailed descriptions, visual heat scale indicators, and customer-friendly guidance on each level from mild to extra hot.
features.rationale: Addresses major competitor pain point - Mrs. Renfro's, Herdez, and Desert Pepper all have complaints about inaccurate or confusing heat levels. Clear heat guidance is a key differentiator.
acceptance_criteria: Visual heat scale (1-5 pepper icons) displayed on all product cards
Detailed heat level descriptions explaining what to expect (e.g., 'Level 3: Medium - noticeable kick, great for most palates')
Filter products by heat level on catalog pages
Heat level comparison when viewing multiple products
Consistent heat labeling across all 25+ products
user_stories: As a salsa enthusiast, I want to clearly understand the heat level before purchasing so that I get products matching my spice tolerance
As a gift buyer, I want clear heat guidance so that I can select appropriate products for recipients

features.title: Subscription Program
features.description: Launch a customizable salsa subscription service with flexible delivery schedules, flavor preferences, heat level preferences, and easy management portal. Unlike Amazing Clubs which curates random brands, Jose Madrid subscriptions guarantee consistent quality from trusted family recipes.
features.rationale: Major market gap - no artisan salsa brand offers customizable subscriptions. Amazing Clubs offers subscriptions but with no flavor control and inconsistent quality across makers. This creates recurring revenue and deepens customer relationships.
acceptance_criteria: Customers can select subscription frequency (weekly, bi-weekly, monthly)
Flavor preferences allow including/excluding specific products
Heat level preference ensures all products match desired spiciness
Subscription management portal for pause, skip, cancel, and modify
Automatic billing via Stripe recurring payments
Subscription discount applied (e.g., 10% off regular prices)
Email notifications before each shipment with option to modify
user_stories: As a salsa enthusiast, I want regular deliveries of my favorite salsas so that I never run out
As a subscriber, I want to customize my box so that I only receive flavors and heat levels I enjoy
As a busy professional, I want to easily manage my subscription online so that I can pause or adjust as needed

features.title: Loyalty Rewards Program
features.description: Implement a points-based loyalty program where customers earn points on purchases, reviews, and referrals, redeemable for discounts on future orders.
features.rationale: No competitor has a strong loyalty program. This addresses customer retention, increases lifetime value, and creates competitive moat. Rewards repeat purchasers who currently have no incentive beyond product quality.
acceptance_criteria: Customers earn points for every dollar spent (e.g., 1 point per $1)
Bonus points for leaving reviews, referrals, and birthday
Points dashboard showing balance, history, and redemption options
Tiered membership levels (Bronze, Silver, Gold) with increasing benefits
Points redeemable for dollar discounts at checkout
Email notifications for points earned and milestone achievements
user_stories: As a repeat customer, I want to earn rewards for my purchases so that my loyalty is recognized
As a customer, I want to see my points balance so that I know how close I am to a reward
As a salsa lover, I want to earn bonus points for writing reviews so that I'm incentivized to share my experience

features.title: Product Comparison Tool
features.description: Allow customers to compare multiple salsa products side-by-side, showing heat level, ingredients, flavor profile, customer ratings, and suggested uses.
features.rationale: Identified as a known gap in current functionality. Helps customers make confident decisions when choosing between 25+ flavors, reducing choice paralysis and abandoned carts.
acceptance_criteria: Add to compare button on product cards and detail pages
Compare up to 4 products side-by-side
Comparison shows: heat level, ingredients, price, ratings, sizes available
Highlight differences between compared products
Add to cart directly from comparison view
Share comparison via link
user_stories: As a new customer, I want to compare different salsas so that I can choose the best ones for my taste
As a gift buyer, I want to compare products so that I can select the perfect variety pack

features.title: Ingredient Sourcing Stories
features.description: Add detailed ingredient sourcing information to product pages, including stories about California Pear tomatoes, authentic chile peppers, and the 35-year family recipe commitment.
features.rationale: Addresses competitor pain points around processed taste (Mrs. Renfro's, Herdez) and recipe changes. Customers want transparency - showcasing premium ingredients and unchanged recipes builds trust and justifies premium positioning.
acceptance_criteria: Each product page includes ingredient sourcing highlights
Dedicated 'Our Ingredients' page with full sourcing stories
Visual badges for key ingredients (California Pear tomatoes, authentic chiles)
'Recipe Never Changed' badge/messaging on applicable products
Mobile-friendly expandable sections for ingredient details
user_stories: As a health-conscious consumer, I want to know where ingredients come from so that I can trust the quality
As a customer, I want to know the recipes haven't changed so that I can trust the product will taste the same

features.title: Enhanced Fundraising Portal
features.description: Upgrade the fundraising program with online campaign management, participant tracking, real-time sales dashboards, and digital ordering for supporters.
features.rationale: Fundraising is a key differentiator - very few competitors offer this channel. Enhancing it with modern tools makes the program more attractive to schools, churches, and nonprofits, driving volume sales.
acceptance_criteria: Organizations can create and manage fundraising campaigns online
Participants get unique referral links to share with supporters
Real-time dashboard showing campaign progress and individual sales
Supporters can order online with automatic attribution to participant
Automated profit calculation and payout tracking
Email templates for campaign promotion
Mobile-friendly ordering for supporters
user_stories: As a fundraising coordinator, I want to track campaign progress in real-time so that I can motivate participants
As a fundraiser participant, I want a shareable link so that my supporters can easily order online
As a supporter, I want to order online so that I don't need to handle cash or paper forms

features.title: Salsa Heat Preference Quiz
features.description: Interactive quiz that helps customers discover their ideal heat level and recommends products based on their taste preferences, spice tolerance, and intended uses.
features.rationale: Engages customers who are unsure about their heat preference - a common barrier to purchase. Addresses competitor issue of mismatched expectations on heat levels by setting appropriate expectations upfront.
acceptance_criteria: 5-7 question quiz about spice tolerance and flavor preferences
Personalized results with recommended products
Option to save preferences to account
Results shareable on social media
Quiz accessible from homepage and product pages
Email capture option for non-logged-in users
user_stories: As a new customer, I want to take a quiz so that I can find salsas matching my taste
As a gift buyer, I want to know what heat level to buy so that I don't get something too spicy for the recipient

features.title: Referral Program
features.description: Implement refer-a-friend program where existing customers earn rewards for bringing in new customers, who also receive a welcome discount.
features.rationale: Word-of-mouth is powerful for artisan food brands. Referrals have higher conversion and retention rates. Creates viral loop for customer acquisition.
acceptance_criteria: Unique referral link for each customer
Referred customer gets $5 off first order
Referrer earns $10 credit when referee makes first purchase
Referral dashboard showing invites sent and conversions
Social sharing buttons for referral link
Integration with loyalty program for bonus points
user_stories: As a happy customer, I want to share my referral link so that I can earn rewards for spreading the word
As a new customer, I want a discount for being referred so that I'm incentivized to try the products

features.title: Wholesale Portal Improvements
features.description: Enhance the wholesale ordering experience with bulk pricing tiers, inventory visibility, order templates for repeat orders, and improved account management.
features.rationale: Wholesale is a key revenue channel. Competitors like Mateo's primarily rely on Costco distribution - direct wholesale relationships are a competitive advantage.
acceptance_criteria: Volume-based pricing tiers displayed clearly
Real-time inventory levels visible to wholesale customers
Saved order templates for quick reordering
Net payment terms management (Net 30, etc.)
Dedicated account manager contact displayed
Order history with invoice downloads
Shipping tracking integration
user_stories: As a wholesale buyer, I want to see bulk pricing so that I can calculate my margins
As a retail store manager, I want to quickly reorder my regular products so that I save time
As a wholesale customer, I want to see inventory levels so that I know what's available before ordering

features.title: Mobile App
features.description: Native mobile application for iOS and Android providing streamlined shopping experience, push notifications for orders and promotions, and loyalty program integration.
features.rationale: Identified as a known gap. Mobile commerce continues to grow. App provides direct channel to customers without competing with email inbox clutter.
acceptance_criteria: Native iOS and Android apps
Full product catalog with search and filtering
Checkout with Apple Pay and Google Pay
Push notifications for order updates
Loyalty points balance and redemption
Subscription management
Reorder from order history with one tap
user_stories: As a mobile user, I want an app so that I can quickly reorder my favorite salsas
As a subscriber, I want push notifications so that I know when my next shipment is coming

features.title: Custom Gift Bundle Builder
features.description: Allow customers to create custom gift boxes by selecting individual products, adding gift messages, and choosing premium packaging options.
features.rationale: Gift buyers are a key secondary audience. Custom bundles increase average order value and make Jose Madrid a go-to destination for food gifts.
acceptance_criteria: Visual gift box builder with drag-and-drop
Pre-set bundle suggestions for different occasions
Custom gift message included with order
Premium packaging options at additional cost
Gift-specific checkout flow
Option to ship directly to recipient with no pricing shown
user_stories: As a gift buyer, I want to create a custom gift box so that I can personalize the gift
As a corporate gift buyer, I want to ship directly to recipients so that gifts arrive without my intervention

features.title: Corporate & Events Portal
features.description: Dedicated ordering portal for corporate customers and event planners with bulk ordering, custom labeling options, and dedicated account support.
features.rationale: Expands into B2B market with corporate gifting and event catering. Higher margins and larger orders than typical consumer purchases.
acceptance_criteria: Separate corporate account registration and approval process
Custom labeling options for corporate gifts
Event quantity ordering with delivery coordination
Dedicated account support contact
Invoice-based payment options
Corporate discount tiers
user_stories: As a corporate buyer, I want to order branded gifts for employees so that I can give meaningful, quality gifts
As an event planner, I want to order large quantities with coordinated delivery so that I can feature salsa at my event
